svg.data-weight-note: 32 lb (14.5 kg per the guide, 32.5 lb or 14.74 kg per the datasheet) with FRUs installed (Table 3)
svg.data-depth-note: 22.44 in (57 cm), not including the handles of the fans and supplies (Table 3)
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 GbE with SFP+ optics; 1 GbE or 100 Mbps with SFP optics
svg.data-qsfp-plus-speeds: 40 GbE; or four 10 GbE with a breakout cable
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC single phase, 50 to 60 Hz (the legend in guide Figure 21 reads 4.5 A, 2 A). The guide's table gives no value.
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, 10 A maximum (guide Table 17)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two 850 W supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; both should be installed
svg.data-fans: three fan modules, hot-swappable; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing; 5 to 93 percent short term
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 2000 m (6562 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches in a ring; also a Virtual Chassis Fabric leaf or spine
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+, 1 GbE and 100 Mbps SFP, SFP+ direct attach cable and active optical cable
svg.data-optics-qsfp: 40 GbE QSFP+, QSFP+ direct attach and active optical cable, breakout cables to SFP+
svg.data-channelization: up to 104 logical 10 GbE ports with the QSFP+ ports broken out (guide, Port Panel of a QFX5100-96S Device)
svg.data-oob: management port C0 (RJ-45, em0) and C1 (SFP, em1) with link and status lamps
svg.data-usb: one USB port for image updates
